auth_failed.message: The Ambientika cloud rejected the stored credentials. Reauthenticate the integration.

update_failed.message: Unable to update from the Ambientika cloud: {details}

schedule_read_only.message: The weekly schedule of this unit is read-only. The account needs the weekly scheduler feature and the unit must report a schedule.

schedule_write_failed.message: The Ambientika cloud did not accept the schedule change.

schedule_invalid_time.message: The {field} time must be a time of day with zero seconds, for example 07:30.

schedule_time_order.message: The start time must be before the end time on the same day. Time slots cannot cross midnight.

schedule_invalid_value.message: {value} is not allowed for {field} in a time slot.

time_slot_overlap.message: The time slot overlaps another time slot on the same day.

time_slot_not_found.message: This time slot does not exist.

time_slot_incomplete.message: A new time slot needs a day, a start time, an end time and an operating mode.

clear_schedule_not_confirmed.message: Turn on the confirmation to delete all time slots.

calendar_event_not_weekly.message: Only events that repeat weekly on their own weekday can be stored as a time slot, without end date, count or interval.

calendar_event_not_representable.message: A time slot starts and ends on the same day at a full minute. All-day events cannot be stored.

calendar_event_mode_missing.message: Name the operating mode in the event title (for example Night) or write mode: night in the description.

calendar_recurrence_unsupported.message: A single occurrence cannot be changed. Edit or delete the whole weekly event.

init.title: Ambientika options
init.description: Choose how often the Ambientika cloud is polled. The unit reports about every 30 seconds, so shorter intervals bring nothing. After a command the integration polls every 30 seconds for three minutes, and it slows down automatically while the cloud is unreachable.

set_state.name: Set state
set_state.description: Set the operating mode, fan speed, humidity target and light sensor sensitivity in one command. Only the given values change.

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: New fan speed; only for modes with a selectable speed.

humidity_level.name: Humidity target
humidity_level.description: New humidity target; only in Automatic and Surveillance mode.

light_sensor_level.name: Light sensor sensitivity
light_sensor_level.description: New light sensor sensitivity; only in Smart and Automatic mode.

set_time_slot.name: Set time slot
set_time_slot.description: Create a weekly time slot, or change an existing one when a time slot identifier is given. Values you leave out stay unchanged. The slot must not overlap another slot on the same day.

slot_id.name: Time slot
slot_id.description: Identifier of an existing time slot to change. Leave empty to create a new one. Use Get schedule to list identifiers.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start time. Seconds must be zero.

end.name: End
end.description: End time on the same day, after the start. Seconds must be zero.

operating_mode.name: Operating mode
operating_mode.description: Operating mode of the time slot.

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: Fan speed. Defaults to low for a new time slot. Turbo only if the unit allows it.

humidity_level.name: Humidity target
humidity_level.description: Humidity target. Defaults to normal for a new time slot.

light_sensor_level.name: Light sensor sensitivity
light_sensor_level.description: Light sensor sensitivity. Defaults to off for a new time slot.

slot_id.name: Time slot
slot_id.description: Identifier of the time slot to delete.

clear_schedule.name: Clear schedule
clear_schedule.description: Delete all weekly time slots of the unit. This cannot be undone.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be turned on to delete all time slots.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the weekly time slots of the unit, with their identifiers.
